$comment: Portable specification of the Thai bank-collections deterministic rules currently
Purpose: the agentic CX designer blog observes that if the process is already
written down, you already have the part that takes longest. This file is that
written-down process, in a form a designer build can be checked against.
Every expectation here is asserted against the live engine by
tests/test_acxd_spike.py, so this file cannot drift into aspiration. It states
what the engine does today, not what we hope a rebuild will do.
Rules are split by who must own them. 'deterministic' rules must never be left to
a model; they map to deterministic nodes with slots, regex validation, retry counts
and explicit escalation paths. 'agentic' rules are the parts a Generative Journey

identity_verification.statement: No account figure may be disclosed before the caller confirms identity.
identity_verification.detail: Balance and due date are spoken only after identityConfirmed. Keypad entry is used because Contact Lens cannot redact Thai audio, and recording is suppressed around digit entry.
identity_verification.acxd_mapping: Deterministic node with a custom slot type constrained to a short list of valid PINs, plus recording suppression around the node.

payment_method_choice.statement: The caller chooses exactly one payment method from a fixed set.

payment_date_capture.acxd_mapping: Built-in date slot plus a custom regex/validation layer for Thai numerals and abbreviated months. A dot-separated pair must stay a time, not a date, because the same validator guards callback and appointment slots.

payment_amount_capture.statement: A partial payment amount must be above zero, at or below the outstanding balance, and at least one percent of it.
payment_amount_capture.acxd_mapping: Deterministic node calling a data request for the balance, then validating the captured amount against it. The floor is policy, not physics, and belongs in one place.

assistance_option_choice.statement: A caller who cannot pay is offered named relief options and the chosen one is recorded, never approved.
assistance_option_choice.detail: The first reply to hardship must offer relief rather than more ways to pay. Approval is a human decision, so the wording commits only to a follow-up.

escape_hatch.statement: Asking for a person always works immediately, even mid-self-service.
utterances: ขอคุยกับเจ้าหน้าที่ค่ะ

unclear_answer.statement: Re-ask once, then fall back to a human referral rather than looping a menu.

assistance_option_choice.acxd_mapping: Custom slot type with three constrained values, a guardrail forbidding approval language, and an escalation path on the second validation failure.

protective_signal_routing.statement: Protective signals are detected before any model judgement and outrank the collections objective.

do_not_contact.note: Honouring a contact ban means ending the call, not routing it to a person who would speak anyway.

hardship.note: Bank only. Insurance and brokerage transfer to a licensed person by regulation.

licensed_boundary.statement: Affordability and investment discussion with a distressed customer requires a licensed human.

protective_signal_routing.acxd_mapping: Guardrails evaluated every turn, or deterministic nodes ahead of the Generative Journey node. Either way these must not be prompt instructions.

handoff_contract.statement: Anything the assistant promises must not depend on a runtime lookup succeeding, and a promise of a transfer must be matched by an actual transfer.
handoff_contract.acxd_mapping: Canvas state passes collected slots, variables and tool results to the receiving agent, which replaces the attribute plumbing we debugged three times.
